# AlphaPath Academy Admin Dashboard - Setup Instructions

## Project Overview
React + TypeScript admin dashboard for managing AlphaPath Academy platform.

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Verify copilot-instructions.md file created
- [x] Clarify Project Requirements - React admin dashboard with course management, user management, analytics
- [ ] Scaffold the Project - Create Vite + React + TypeScript project structure
- [ ] Customize the Project - Add admin features and API integration
- [ ] Install Required Extensions - Install recommended VS Code extensions
- [ ] Compile the Project - Install dependencies and verify build
- [ ] Create and Run Task - Set up dev server task
- [ ] Launch the Project - Start development server
- [ ] Ensure Documentation is Complete - Update README and instructions

## Technical Stack
- React 18 + TypeScript
- Vite (build tool)
- TailwindCSS (styling)
- React Router (routing)
- React Query (data fetching)
- Zustand (state management)
- shadcn/ui (UI components)
- Axios (API client)
- Recharts (analytics)

## Features
- Course Management (CRUD operations)
- User Management
- Analytics Dashboard
- Content Moderation
- Subscription Management
- Payment Tracking
